Thanks for the ping. I audited the customer’s remittance against our AR ledger. Key findings: 
- Wire of $236,700 received and partially applied to INV-7892 ($188,200).
- A VAT credit CN-321 for $12,400 exists but the payment reference on the wire came through as "CN321" (no dash). Our cash-application rules use exact invoice/credit numbers; CN321 didn’t match so the credit remained unapplied in the system and shows up as unapplied AR.
- The remaining unapplied balance of $48,500 is a combination of: CN-321 $12,400 (VAT credit) + short-application on INV-7901 for $36,100 (system split).

Recommendation:
1) Post a correcting journal JE-2026-07-19-UNAPPLY to move the $12,400 from unapplied AR to the tax liability account (VAT payable credit) and reduce AR accordingly.
2) Re-run cash-application for the wire with relaxed matching to allocate the $36,100 against INV-7901.
3) Confirm revenue recognition mapping: this adjustment is a pure tax credit and should not change recognized revenue—no revrec entry required, but we should tag the JE so RevRec team can confirm no impact.

I’ve attached a draft journal worksheet (journal_adjustment_draft.xlsx) with suggested GLs and narrative. If you approve, I’ll post the JE and reapply the payment.

Marcus Lin
